label: Weekly Shopify report
text: Every Monday I export Shopify orders to Google Sheets and build a sales summary. I use Claude Desktop, and ChatGPT at work.

items.text: Every Monday, you export your Shopify orders to Google Sheets
items.quote: Every Monday I export Shopify orders to Google Sheets

items.text: Then you build a sales summary from those orders
You also use ChatGPT at work

needs.reason: Claude Desktop already does this on paid plans. Set up a scheduled task to run this report every Monday. It runs even while your computer is asleep. Nothing to add.

shopify-connector.why: You export your Shopify orders every Monday. This lets Claude read them straight from your store instead.
shopify-connector.how_it_helps: It's step one of your Monday report. Claude gets the orders, then Google Drive lets it put them in your sheet.
shopify-connector.do_you_need_it: Add it now if you'd rather Claude get your orders than export them yourself. Without it, Claude can't see your store.
shopify-connector.skip_if: Skip it if Shopify's own reports already show you everything you need.
shopify-connector.summary: Shopify's own add-on for Claude: it reads your orders, customers and sales. It can also change products, so ask it for reports only.

google-drive-connector.why: Your orders end up in a Google Sheet every week. This lets Claude open that sheet and add each new week for you.
google-drive-connector.how_it_helps: It's step two of your Monday report. Once Claude has the week's orders from Shopify, this puts them in your sheet.
google-drive-connector.do_you_need_it: Add it now if your report stays in Google Sheets.
google-drive-connector.skip_if: Skip it if you'd rather read the summary in Claude and stop using the sheet.
google-drive-connector.summary: Google's own add-on for Claude: it finds, opens and saves files in your Google Drive, including Google Sheets.

claude-for-google-sheets.why: You build your sales summary by hand each week. With this, Claude can add up the totals and write the formulas with you.
claude-for-google-sheets.how_it_helps: It's the last step of your Monday report. Once the week's orders are in your sheet, Claude can add them up right there.
claude-for-google-sheets.do_you_need_it: Add it now if you like building the summary in your sheet. Otherwise, Claude Desktop can write it for you with the Shopify and Google Drive picks.
claude-for-google-sheets.skip_if: Skip it if your work or school blocks add-ons on your Google account.
claude-for-google-sheets.summary: Anthropic's own add-on for Google Sheets, Docs and Slides: a Claude panel inside your file. Still in testing, and only on paid plans.
